method: One fixed limit-checked joint-reference proposal. No existing validated roll planner exists. Exact FK audit only; physical executability is decided by the first actual-WASM run.

proposal.positionVelocityReference: quintic Hermite with coherent derivative and zero endpoint acceleration
proposal.feedforward: original hinge passive spring and damping only

trigger: Observed quiet grounded supine anatomy and true current motion; never fixture identity.
contactSequence: right-lateral for20 consecutive actual native samples
passive grounded quiet prone for120 consecutive native samples

firstEvaluation.carry: enabled once at native0 before passive fixture preparation
firstEvaluation.stopIf: preparation, original recovery or30s anchored hold fails; reject candidate and do not try another route

conditionalNextCase: Only if complete first case passes: one nonidentical initial supine construction with45degree world-Y heading, same joint coordinates, route, profile and original criteria; no pose writes after construction. Then other-pose and repeated-fall regressions.
forbidden: forecast state copied into real world
